title: Answer: experience is caused by the brain, yet not physical

statements.text: Experience has qualitative character, the qualia Mary learns about on release, which no physical information captures. It is derived in the causal sense, since brain events produce it, but not in the sense of being reducible: it is a nonphysical addition to the physical world, with no effects of its own.

sources.quote: what she learns must be some other kind of information, which we may call “phenomenal information”
